create_string_formatter: create a StringFormatter to generate console-ready string representation of a pandas DataFrame
summarize_dataframe_to_string: summarize a pandas DataFrame to a formatted string with truncation and terminal width handling
format_truncated_dataframe: format a truncated DataFrame with dot separators for horizontal and vertical truncation
join_multiline_dataframe: join multiline DataFrame columns into wrapped string output respecting line width
fit_dataframe_to_terminal: fit DataFrame column output to the current terminal width with automatic truncation
